items.title: Canada tariffs put loonie, supply chains in focus as trade war deepens
items.summary: Investing.com -- Canada’s C$27.6 billion retaliation against U.S. imports took effect on Tuesday, putting the Canadian dollar and North American supply chains under fresh pressure as investors assessed the risk that a widening trade war will drive up costs and disrupt cross-border commerce.

items.title: Copper Prices Hit Record High. These Stocks Are Jumping.
items.summary: Copper prices hit a record high Tuesday due to concerns over potential U.S. tariffs and supply problems amid surging demand for AI data-center infrastructure.

items.title: Freeport-McMoRan shares surge as copper hits record $14,694/ton
items.summary: Each 10-cent rise in the copper price is worth approximately $390 million in annual EBITDA for Freeport-McMoRan, per its own management sensitivity model, making Tuesday's record-setting session a material earnings event in real time.

items.title: Can Southern Copper Sustain Its Strong Operating Cash Flow Growth?
items.summary: SCCO's cash flow surges 116.9% in H1'26, aided by higher sales, lower costs and rising metal prices.

items.title: Freeport-McMoRan Has Ripped 44% in 2026. What Would It Take to Get FCX Stock Up to $100?
items.summary: Copper's explosive rally has sent FCX shares surging nearly halfway toward a triple-digit price tag, but the path to $100 runs through a precise set of conditions that have nothing to do with Freeport-McMoRan's own execution.

items.title: Copper Just Soared to an All-Time High, but This Stock Is Still a Great Value
items.summary: The current copper price supports Freeport-McMoRan's valuation, and its end-market and production outlook are excellent.

items.title: Jim Cramer Saw Copper Reaching $100, Yet One Trader Bought the Drop
items.summary: Jim Cramer mapped a copper rally to $100, then the breakout level collapsed within days. Now one portfolio manager is loading up on the dip and has already named the single event that would force him to abandon the entire trade.

items.title: Centrus Energy (LEU) Down 4.3% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Rebound?
